thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up: assign owners + deadlines for vendor/dependency mitigations (cloud auth spikes + model-registry flakiness).

maya: Short plan: two hotfixes this week, hardening + a drill across teams next sprint. I'll create action rows once owners confirm.

alex: I can own cloud fallback automation (cross-region routing + retry/circuit-breaker). Prototype + dry-run by Fri.

jordan: I'll own registry auth TTL rotation, clearer 400/401/5xx taxonomy, and a synthetic canary. PR by Tue, canary Thu.

anika: Alerts and runbook updates are mine. Will add pager thresholds and a short playbook; aim to merge alerts by Thu.

liam: I'll coordinate the failover drill (simulate auth region outage + registry degradation). Propose Wed week-after-next; I'll draft checklist.

maya: Proposed action items: A1 cloud fallback (alex) - dry-run Fri, merge Tue; A2 registry TTL & checks (jordan) - PR Tue, canary Thu; A3 alerts+runbook (anika) - Thu; A4 failover drill (liam) - plan Mon, drill Wed; A5 temp retry bump (owner: maya) - short window tweak during spikes.

maya: Observed recurring patterns: auth token bursts ~20:45 UTC align with provider control-plane throttles; registry 5xx spikes during autoscaler windows. Instrumentation to add: auth 429/5xx per minute, registry queue depth & smoothed 5xx rate, cross-region fallback success-rate.

alex: For A1: shim routes to secondary region after 3 auth failures in 30s with circuit-breaker. We'll retry first (3x small backoff) then fallback; track fallback metric separately.

anika: Agree on retry-first, fallback threshold alert if fallback rate >1% over 5m. I'll update runbook and dashboards.

jordan: Adding upstream provider ID to registry logs to aid correlation and a 15s canary probe for latency/5xx.

liam: Drill plan will ensure model-serving falls back to pinned cache and console shows degraded-but-operational. Include rollback steps and post-drill retro.

maya: I'll open action-tracker rows A1..A5 now and set priorities. If auth spikes >2 times in 2 weeks we trigger vendor SLA review.

deploy-bot: IncidentBot: runbook "vendor-fallbacks" updated by anika - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vendor-fallbacks :white_check_mark:

maya: Closing loop  owners confirmed: alex(A1), jordan(A2), anika(A3), liam(A4), maya(A5). Timelines recorded in tracker; comment to reassign.
